game.title: 2D Action RPG Prototype
game.core_loop: Explore biomes, fight enemies, complete short quests

factions.goal: Secure routes and weaken castle defenses.
Secure routes and weaken castle defenses.

world.description: A small world with two main biomes (Forest and Desert) and a contested Castle area in between. Both biomes have bandit enemies, and the Castle is a strategic point of conflict. both biomes have areas indside ready to be used by quests. forest has 3 areas and desert has 2 areas.

world.conflict: end goal of both factions, Forest and Desert forces, is to attempt to conquer the Castle.

quest_guidelines.structure: Linear, 3-5 steps, no branching dialogue. invent over all narrative context and character details, but keep quest steps simple and clear.
quest_guidelines.clarity: Each step must map to a known step type and known target IDs.
quest_guidelines.player_adaptation: Prefer exploration steps for explorers, combat steps for killers.
